defs.def: according to what you have heard or read; according to the way sth appears 据 … 所知；看来；显然

ex.s: I parked my car outside the farm and walked past a milking house which had apparently not been used in many years.
ex.t: 我把车停在农场外，走过一座显然多年未用的挤奶房。

ex.s: Above all, I hoped he wouldn't assign me to work with the fiercely competitive, extremely serious fellow who always wore dark clothes and apparently had a personality to match.
ex.t: 最重要的是，我希望他不要把我分配给那个竞争激烈、极其严肃、总是穿深色衣服、性格也和穿着一样的人一起工作。
但我们坚持说它只是   45   一扇窗户，这使他们避免了   46   数百万次要求开门。

ex.s: I couldn’t see Don, but as I _____50_____ the tractor he jumped out onto the road, apparently _____51_____ , and dashed back to me.
ex.t: 警察   _____52_____ 到了高速公路恢复正常运行。

ex.s: Stars apparently do not follow this basic principle of sportsmanship.
ex.t: 确定天赋的性质并不是一件简单的事情。

ex.s: Apparently, the idea of money that's not tied to a specific bank — or a specific country — is appealing to many.
ex.t: 不久以前，货币几乎总是在当地创造和使用，物物交换很常见。

ex.s: 14 hours later the films had lost 13% of their mass — apparently broken down by enzymes (酶) from the worms’ stomachs.
Well, the future is apparently now.
ex.t: 更少的排放和更便宜的出行听起来相当有吸引力。

ex.s: Scientists have found that all kinds of plants give out VOCs when being attacked .It’s a plant’s way of crying out.But is anyone listening?Apparently.Because we can watch the neighbors react.
ex.t: 弗雷迪是一个普通的____，但他不是一个普通人。

ex.s: For the first criterion, Shennongjia is apparently one of the most “complete” natural areas in the world.
ex.t: 对于第一个标准，神农架显然是世界上最“完整”的自然区域之一。

ex.s: It is perennially young, and I may stand and see a swallow dip apparently to pick an insect from its surface as of yore.
ex.t: 它常年年轻，我可能会站在那里看到一只燕子俯冲，显然是从过去的表面采摘一只昆虫。

ex.s: She concluded that boiling the sweet wormwood apparently destroyed its medical properties.
ex.t: 她的结论是，煮沸甜艾显然破坏了它的医学特性。

ex.s: My niece came in to fetch something, maybe her handkerchief, apparently without seeing me.
ex.t: 我的侄女进来拿东西，也许是她的手帕，显然没有看见我。

ex.s: Stephen Hawking, for example, warned, "The development of full artificial intelligence could spell the end of the human race." Apparently, such warnings demand our attention.
ex.t: 例如，斯蒂芬·霍金（ Stephen Hawking ）警告说： “完全人工智能的发展可能意味着人类的终结。“显然，这样的警告需要引起我们的注意。
